title: Effective affine descents glue on invariant open neighbourhoods
statement: Let $p:X\to Y$ be finite, flat and surjective and $D$ a transport descent datum [def-pd-descent-datum] on $V\to X$. Suppose every point of $V$ has a transport-invariant affine neighbourhood $U$, contained in the inverse image of an affine open $B\subseteq Y$. Here invariant means that any test-scheme point whose image is in $U$ remains in $U$ after transport. Then $D$ is effective: there is $V_0\to Y$ and a transport-invariant projection $q:V\to V_0$ whose square over $p$ is cartesian [def-pc-base-change]. No finite-subset affine-neighbourhood hypothesis is used here.

source.place: Descent, Tags 0AP4 and 0245; Groupoid Schemes, proof of Tag 0H8K

proof.text: Choose an invariant affine neighbourhood U_v for each point v. Construct its restricted transport by lifting D.transport through the open immersion U_v -> V. The lift factorization and monicity prove naturality, identity and cocycle, and show the inclusion intertwines transport. This is the proved private helper exists_datum_on_invariant_open.

For each U_v choose its affine base open B. Lift U_v -> X through X_B = p^{-1}(B). The private exists_datum_over_mono_base constructs the same transport over X_B -> B using monicity of X_B -> X. Finiteness of p makes X_B affine; U_v is affine, hence U_v -> X_B is an affine morphism. The restricted p is flat, surjective and quasi-compact by base change, so is a singleton fpqc cover. Apply isEffective_of_isAffineHom_fpqc. Paste its pullback square with isPullback_morphismRestrict p B to obtain the effective square over Y. For an arbitrary test point a and its transport b, their composites with U_v -> X_B lift both maps to X. Monicity of B -> Y gives their equality over B. The compatibility of the restricted transport and its invariant projection then proves the original transport invariance. This is the fully proved private helper isEffective_of_affine_above_affine_open.

Apply isEffective_of_effective_open_cover to the cover indexed by V points, its restricted data, their transport compatibility and the local effectiveness proved in the previous step. The covering witness for a point x is the selected open U_x. This is Tag 0AP4 and also covers the empty index case.

proof_origin.place: Descent, Tags 0245 and 0AP4; local restriction and affine-base steps fully formalized, general compatible-open gluing isolated as lem-pd-effective-invariant-open-cover

lean.statement: theorem isEffective_of_invariant_affine_neighbourhoods {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {p : X ⟶ Y} [IsFinite p] [Flat p] [Surjective p] {V : Over X} (D : Over.DescentDatum p V) (hcover : ∀ v : V.left, ∃ U : V.left.Opens, v ∈ U ∧ IsAffineOpen U ∧ (∃ B : Y.Opens, IsAffineOpen B ∧ U ≤ (V.hom ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ B) ∧ ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (f₁ f₂ : T ⟶ X) (h : f₁ ≫ p = f₂ ≫ p) (a : Over.mk f₁ ⟶ V), Set.range a.left ⊆ U → Set.range (D.transport f₁ f₂ h a).left ⊆ U) : D.IsEffective
